description: Use when you want to BUY a token in size (a block trade) without moving the market price: posts a private request for quotes on Bull, the modular, non-custodial settlement layer for OTC and agent-to-agent deals. Returns an rfqId; sellers answer with sealed quotes only you can read. Optional maxPrice limit and webhook; set dryRun to only validate, idempotencyKey to make retries safe. Not for small market swaps (use a DEX) or paying for API calls (use x402). Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

dryRun.description: true = only check the request, nothing is created. Optional.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8-64 characters) so a retry never creates a duplicate. Optional.

maxPrice.description: Your limit: the most you will pay in total, in ETH (optional). Quotes above it are refused.

ref.description: Partner code of the project that sends you (optional). Claim one at https://www.bull.family/partners.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

token.description: Token contract address you want to buy.

webhook.description: https URL that receives events: quote.received, quote.revised, deal.settled (optional).

windowMin.description: How long the request stays open, in minutes: 15, 30, 60, 360 or 1440. Default 60.

name: bull_create_rfq
